    DONALD LEE JOINER AND ANITA M. JOINER REQUEST TO ADD
      JOINER EXHIBIT 1 TO SOAH ORDER 30, ATTACHMENT A

      Party 115, Donald Lee Joiner and Anita M. Joiner, request that Item 5632, the

direct testimony of Donald Lee Joiner, filed as Joiner Exhibit 1, Item 5632 (and

uploaded to Kiteworks and Egnyte), be added to Attachment A to SOAH Order 30

and admitted into evidence.

      Donald Lee Joiner’s testimony was originally filed as Item # 4175 along with

the Joiners’ position statement. Donald Lee Joiner’s direct testimony in Item 5632 is

a duplicate of Item 4175 with the position statement deleted.

      The preface to Joiners’ Exhibit 1 incorrectly identified the initial filing as Item

4176. This was a typographical error.




                                           1
       Accordingly, Donald Lee Joiner and Anita M. Joiner, request that Item 5632,

the direct testimony of Donald Lee Joiner, filed as Joiner Exhibit 1, Item 5632, be

added to Attachment A to SOAH Order 30 and admitted into evidence.

                                      Respectfully submitted,
